rules.unit: One card per named mountain-bike riding area or connected network.
rules.source: MTB Project riding-area directory used for discovery and MTB-specific verification.
rules.substantial: At least 5 mapped miles, 5 mapped trail segments, or a recommended MTB route.
rules.smallArea: Smaller named systems retained only with a recommended route and at least 3 mapped miles.
rules.exclusions: Directory containers, locality aggregates, individual/minor fragments, non-MTB uses, and unverified access.
